text:
Sophie: Heads-up — our daily marketplace snapshot is missing entitlements for a handful of HW SKUs in eu-west-1. Noticed during recon vs ledger, about ~1200 missing units across two partners.
Rahul: Oof. Which feed? AWS marketplace or partner webhook?
Sophie: AWS marketplace metering service + one SI partner that replays hourly batches. The missing rows appear to have event timestamps near midnight UTC.
Mateo: Midnight UTC smells like windowing/timezone edgecase. If partner batch uses local date cut we can lose or double-count. Do we have a proof-of-failure?
Sophie: I pulled the raw marketplace CSV and internal ingestion logs. Looks like the marketplace snapshot file for eu-west-1 had file_mod_time 2025-11-02T23:59:58Z, and our ingestion job used a cutoff of <= 2025-11-02T23:59:00Z. So ~58s of events dropped.
Rahul: Ack. That's the race. Our checkpoint uses file arrival time, not file_mod_time. If the vendor does last-second appends, we can miss.
Mateo: Two fixes: extend the ingestion grace window by 60s and make ingestion idempotent keyed by marketplace_event_id + partner_id. Also consider reprocessing any 'late' files in a backfill job.
Elena: For partner comms, we should avoid blame. Draft note: "We observed a timing window where last-second usage updates are excluded by our ingestion cutoff; we're implementing a short grace window and a backfill and will credit impacted customers." Thoughts?
Jin (sales): Please flag any customers affected (high ARR) so AE outreach can be coordinated. We can't have surprises in billing.
BillingBot: Created ticket BILL-5421: "ingest-window race: eu-west-1 marketplace snapshots" assigned to @rahul, severity: P2.
Rahul: Plan: 1) quick fix: bump cutoff to <= file_mod_time (prod change) and add 65s grace; 2) add idempotency keys in ingestion layer; 3) run backfill for last 7 days for eu-west-1. I'll prototype the cutoff change in staging.
Mateo: ETA for staging change?
Rahul: I'll aim for a tested staging rollout within 2 hours, prod after rollback window tomorrow morning.
Sophie: For the backfill — do we re-run the existing batch job or write a one-off reconciler? Backfills can cause duplicates unless idempotency is solid.
Mateo: One-off reconciler that writes to a reconciliation table first, with a dry-run mode. Only commit deltas after manual review. We'll need mapping from marketplace SKU -> internal entitlement_id; I have a partial mapping but missing two SKUs from partner XYZ.
Elena: I'll ask partner XYZ for canonical SKU list and event ids. Also will prepare a short customer-facing note and a partner-facing troubleshooting doc.
Jin (sales): Assign me the list of customers that may see credits so I can prep comms.
BillingBot: Noted: backfill job created as BILL-5421-RECON. Dry-run scheduled.
Sophie: Quick ask: can eng infra verify S3 eventual-consistency effects? If marketplace uploader does 'copy' semantics last-second, we might see inconsistent HEADs.
Mateo: Good call. @eng-infra to confirm S3 listing vs object-mod semantics in our ingestion library. If it's eventual-consistent, we need to rely on file_mod_time and not listing order.
Rahul: I'll add defensive logging: record file_mod_time, s3_etag, and marketplace_event_cnt to make postmortems easier.
Elena: Comms draft timeline: partner ping now, customer comms cadence after recon results (same day if small list, otherwise next-day).
Sophie: Action items: Rahul -> staging cutoff change + idempotency prototype (ETA 2h). Mateo -> reconciler dry-run + mapping, needs partner SKU list (ETA EOD). Elena -> partner note & customer list coordination with Jin (ETA 4h). Jin -> customer outreach prep (ETA after Elena list). BillingBot -> track tasks under BILL-5421.
Rahul: One more: can we add a nightly reconciliation delta report (csv) to partnerships S3 so partners can independently vet usage? Low-effort export that helps transparency.
Elena: Yes — we'll offer that as opt-in. Add to partner docs.
Sophie: OK team — let's do the staging test. I'll follow up in #operations with the staging link. :thumbsup:
Rahul: Starting now.
Mateo: I'll prepare the reconciler skeleton and share a gist.
Elena: Drafting partner note, will post here for review.
Jin (sales): Ready to jump on any customer calls.
BillingBot: BILL-5421 status updated: "in progress".
